# digna Documentation

> Odkrijte digna, evropsko AI-platformo za kakovost podatkov in opazljivost. Zasnovana za on-premises in zasebni oblak, digna nadzoruje kakovost podatkov neposredno v vaših podatkovnih bazah — zagotavlja skladnost, zmogljivost in suverenost podatkov.

## Platforma

- [Overview](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/overview/): Raziščite jedrne module digna — evropske AI platforme za kakovost podatkov in opazovanje. Naučite se, kako vsak modul izboljšuje kakovost, opazljivost in zanesljivost podatkov v vašem lokalnem ali zasebnem oblačnem okolju.

### Profiliranje

- [Uvod](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/profiling/Introduction/): Profiling is the step that measures your data and produces the statistics digna Data Anomalies and digna Data Analytics are built on. It runs as part of those modules, entirely inside your database, and only aggregated numbers ever leave the source.
- [Kako deluje](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/profiling/how_it_works/): The mechanics of digna profiling — the snapshot query and the
- [Statistika](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/profiling/statistics/): The complete reference of statistics digna computes while profiling a data source — Row Count, Null Count, Sum, Average, string lengths, distribution counts — which attribute category enables each one, and how each is translated into SQL.
- [Podatkovni nabori](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/profiling/datasets/): How digna Datasets split a data source into independently monitored subsets. Static datasets filter with a WHERE condition, Dynamic datasets group with GROUP BY, Hybrid datasets do both — plus relevance rules that suppress a status without suppressing measurement.

### digna Data Anomalies

- [Uvod](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_anomalies/Introduction/): Spoznajte, kako digna Data Anomalies samodejno zaznava padce volumna, manjkajoče vrednosti, premike porazdelitev in nepričakovane vzorce brez ročnega pisanja pravil. Izboljšajte kakovost in observabilnost podatkovnih cevovodov z odkrivanjem anomalij, ki ga poganja AI.
- [Kako deluje](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_anomalies/how_it_works/): How digna Data Anomalies works end to end — in-database profiling, robust prediction per series, a tolerance band derived from recent prediction error, and status rollup from check to data source.
- [Primeri uporabe](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_anomalies/use_cases/): Real-world use cases for digna Data Anomalies in banking, healthcare, telecommunications, retail, and the public sector. See how AI-based anomaly detection catches missing loads, distribution drift, swapped columns, and unexpected KPI movements without rules or thresholds.

### digna Data Analytics

- [Uvod](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_analytics/Introduction/): Izvedite, kako digna Data Analytics razkriva dolgoročne trende, nihajnost in stabilnost podatkov preko KPI-jev. Zaznajte premike v kakovosti in opazljivosti podatkov, odkrijte skrite anomalije in spremenite statistiko v uporabne vpoglede.
- [Kako deluje](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_analytics/how_it_works/): How digna Data Analytics works — a regression fitted over a configurable window of profiled statistics, producing absolute and relative change and volatility, evaluated against user-defined limits.
- [Primeri uporabe](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_analytics/use_cases/): Practical use cases for digna Data Analytics. See how trend and volatility analysis over column metrics reveals gradual data quality decay, unstable pipelines, and shifting business KPIs in banking, retail, healthcare, telecommunications, and the public sector.

### digna Data Validation

- [Uvod](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_validation/Introduction/): Odkrijte, kako digna Data Validation izvaja deterministične preverjave na osnovi pravil z mejami, razponi in referenčnimi seznami. Zagotovite skladnost, revizijsko sledljivost in poročanje za regulirana področja, kot so finance in zdravstvo.
- [Kako deluje](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_validation/how_it_works/): How digna Data Validation works — the three rule kinds (rule expressions, uniqueness, referential integrity), how each becomes SQL, absolute and relative thresholds, rule templates, enumerations, and failed-record inspection.
- [Primeri uporabe](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_validation/use_cases/): Practical use cases for digna Data Validation. Record-level rules for invoice compliance, regulatory reporting, reference data integrity, and audit evidence in finance, healthcare, telecommunications, and the public sector.

### digna Timeliness

- [Uvod](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_timeliness/Introduction/): Izvedite, kako digna Data Timeliness zagotavlja, da podatki prispejo pravočasno. Zaznajte zamude ali manjkajoče dostave, spremljajte SLA in zaščitite poslovne procese pred tihimi zamudami. AI-podprta zaznava za izboljšano kakovost podatkov in opaznost podatkovnih tokov.
- [Kako deluje](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_timeliness/how_it_works/): How digna Timeliness works — what counts as a delivery, AI-learned arrival prediction versus rule-based schedules, the alert margin, and how a delivery that never arrived is reported.
- [Primeri uporabe](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/data_timeliness/use_cases/): Real-world use cases for digna Timeliness. Detect late and missing deliveries across large multi-source landscapes — with AI-learned arrival patterns and user-defined schedules for strict data contracts.

### digna Schema Tracker

- [Uvod](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/schema_tracker/Introduction/): Spoznajte, kako digna Data Schema Tracker spremlja spremembe stolpcev, posodobitve podatkovnih tipov in drift shem. Odkrijte in opozorite na namerne in nenamerne spremembe sheme, da preprečite napake ETL, pokvarjene nadzorne plošče in izgubo opazljivosti podatkov.
- [Kako deluje](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/schema_tracker/how_it_works/): How digna Schema Tracker works — a stored column baseline compared on every inspection, the three change events it reports, why a rename appears as a removal plus an addition, and how the baseline advances.
- [Primeri uporabe](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/platform/schema_tracker/use_cases/): Real-world use cases for digna Schema Tracker. Detect added columns, removed columns, and data type changes before they break pipelines, dashboards, and downstream reports — with a timestamped, attributed change history.

## Namestitev in razmestitev

### Operacijski sistemi

### Linux

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/installation_deployment/Linux/Release%202026.06/installation_guide_digna_linux_2026_06/): Step-by-step guide to installing digna Release 2026.06 on Linux — system requirements, PostgreSQL setup, nginx or Apache configuration, backend and dashboard configuration, running digna as a systemd service, and upgrading to a new release.

### macOS

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/installation_deployment/macOS/Release%202026.06/installation_guide_digna_macos_2026_06/): Korak‑po‑korak navodila za namestitev digna izdaje 2026.06 na macOS — sistemske zahteve, nastavitev Homebrew in PostgreSQL, konfiguracija nginx ali Apache, konfiguracija backend‑a in nadzorne plošče, zagon digna kot ozadnega servisa ter nadgradnja na novo izdajo.

### Windows

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/installation_deployment/Windows/Release%202026.06/installation_guide_digna_windows_2026_06/): Korak-po-korak vodič za namestitev digna Release 2026.06 na Windows — sistemske zahteve, nastavitev PostgreSQL, konfiguracija spletnega strežnika, konfiguracija backenda in nadzorne plošče, poganjanje digna kot Windows storitve in nadgradnja na novo verzijo.

- [Kako povezati podatkovno bazo s podatkovnim projektom](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/getting_started/how_to_connect_database_to_data_project/): Korak za korakom vodič za povezavo baze podatkov z obstoječim projektom v digna. Naučite se, kako konfigurirati povezave, vnesti poverilnice in omogočiti varen dostop.
- [Kako dodati vir podatkov projektu](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/getting_started/how_to_add_a_datasource_to_project/): Vodnik po korakih za povezavo podatkovne baze z obstoječim projektom v digna. Naučite se, kako izbrati povezavo, konfigurirati nastavitve in omogočiti varen dostop.

### Razporejanje

- [Kako razporediti dnevno opravilo](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/getting_started/how_to_schedule_a_daily_job/): Naučite se, kako v nadzorni plošči digna razporediti dnevno opravilo za pregled.
- [Kako uporabiti definicijo crontab](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/getting_started/how_to_use_crontab/): Naučite se, kako v digna razporediti opravilo z uporabo crontab izrazov za napredno časovno nastavljanje.

## Integracija

### Podatkovne baze

- [Overview](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/databases/overview/): How database connections work in digna. Every source technology is reached over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string built from ODBC properties. Covers driver installation on the digna host, the Add DB Connection screen, property encryption, connection testing, troubleshooting and links to the per-technology guides.
- [Azure Synapse](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/databases/azure_synapse_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Azure Synapse Analytics over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Supports serverless and dedicated SQL pools, with the required ODBC properties and digna-side connection settings.
- [Databricks](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/databases/databricks_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Databricks with Unity Catalog over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Databricks ODBC driver, personal access tokens, HTTP path and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Hive](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/databases/hive_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Apache Hive over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Cloudera Hive ODBC driver, authentication mechanisms, transport modes and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Netezza](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/databases/netezza_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Netezza over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the NetezzaSQL driver, the required ODBC properties and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Oracle](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/databases/oracle_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Oracle over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Oracle ODBC driver, the DBQ connect descriptor, TNS aliases and the digna-side connection settings.
- [PostgreSQL](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/databases/postgres_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to PostgreSQL over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the psqlODBC driver, the required ODBC properties, SSL modes and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Snowflake](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/databases/snowflake_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Snowflake over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Snowflake ODBC driver, programmatic access tokens, warehouse and role selection and the digna-side connection settings.
- [MS SQL Server](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/databases/sqlserver_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Microsoft SQL Server over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Microsoft ODBC driver, the required ODBC properties, encryption settings and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Teradata](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/databases/teradata_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Teradata over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Teradata ODBC driver, the DBCNAME property, logon mechanisms and the digna-side connection settings.

### Single Sign-On

- [Overview](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/sso/overview/): Kako deluje enotna prijava (SSO) v digna z uporabo OpenID Connect (OIDC). Vsebuje konfiguracijo nadzorne plošče in zaledja, testiranje, odpravljanje težav in povezave do navodil za posamezne ponudnike, kot so Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, OneLogin, PingOne in AD FS.
- [AD FS](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/sso/adfs_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Active Directory Federation Services using OpenID Connect — application group, server application, shared secret, permitted scopes and the matching digna configuration.
- [Auth0](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/sso/auth0_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Auth0 using OpenID Connect — regular web application setup, allowed callback URLs, client credentials, tenant domain and the matching digna configuration.
- [Google Workspace](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/sso/google_workspace_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Google Workspace using OpenID Connect — OAuth consent screen, OAuth client ID, authorized redirect URIs and the matching digna configuration.
- [Keycloak](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/sso/keycloak_sso_guide/): Konfigurirajte enkratno prijavo za digna z Keycloak preko OpenID Connect — nastavitev realm in klienta, overjanje klienta, veljavne URI-ji za preusmeritev, skrivnost klienta in ustrezna konfiguracija digna.
- [Microsoft Entra ID](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/sso/microsoft_entra_id_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) using OpenID Connect — app registration, redirect URI, client secret, tenant ID and the matching digna configuration.
- [Okta](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/sso/okta_sso_guide/): Konfigurirajte Single Sign-On za digna z Okta preko OpenID Connect — integracija aplikacije, preusmeritveni URI-ji za prijavo, poverilnice klienta, izbira avtentikacijskega strežnika in ustrezna digna konfiguracija.
- [OneLogin](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/sso/onelogin_sso_guide/): Konfigurirajte Single Sign-On za digna z OneLogin preko OpenID Connect — ustvarjanje OIDC aplikacije, redirect URI-ji, poverilnice odjemalca, overjanje na token endpointu in ustrezna konfiguracija digna.
- [PingOne](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/sso/pingone_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with PingOne using OpenID Connect — OIDC web app setup, redirect URIs, client credentials, environment ID, regional domains and the matching digna configuration.

- [Release 2024.11](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/cli/Command_Line_Interface_202411/): Celovit priročnik za digna CLI izdajo 2024.11. Naučite se upravljati uporabnike, repozitorije in podatke z ukazi, kot so add-user, check-repo-connection, upgrade-repo, inspect, tls-status in drugi.
- [Release 2024.09](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/cli/Command_Line_Interface_202409/): Complete reference for digna CLI release 2024.09. Learn how to manage users, repositories, and data with commands such as add-user, check-repo-connection, upgrade-repo, inspect, tls-status, and more.

## Changelog

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/changelog/Release_202606/): Ugotovite, kaj je novega v digna Izdaji 2026.06. Ta različica uvaja nov **digna Python SDK**, uradno **Docker podporo za namestitev**, osveženo izkušnjo nadzorne plošče in razširljive možnosti za uvoz/izvoz pravil validacije.
- [Release 2026.04](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/changelog/Release_202604/): Spoznajte novosti v digna izdaji 2026.04. Ta različica uvaja napredno analizo časovnih vrst z Analytics Chart, ponovno uporabne predloge pravil za validacijo, enumeracije za dovoljene vrednosti in pogoje relevantnosti na ravni stolpcev.
- [Release 2026.01](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/changelog/Release_202601/): Izvedite, kaj je novega v digna Release 2026.01. Ta različica uvaja globalne povezave do baz podatkov, logične podatkovne vire, pogoje relevantnosti anomalij, izvoz CSV in napredno Data Validation vključno s preverjanjem referenčne celovitosti.
- [Release 2025.09](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/changelog/Release_202509/): Izvedite, kaj je novega v digna izdaji 2025.09. Ta različica uvaja modularno arhitekturo, pet novih modulov, MFA prek OIDC in obvestila po modulih.
- [Release 2025.04](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/changelog/Release_202504/): Spoznajte novosti v digna izdaji 2025.04. Ta različica uvaja Inspection Hub, večjezično podporo (angleščina, nemščina, poljščina), uvoz/izvoz virov podatkov preko dignacli, prvo izdajo Module Analytics in izboljšano izkušnjo nadzorne plošče.
- [Release 2024.12](https://docs.digna.ai/sl/changelog/Release_202412/): Odkrijte, kaj je novega v digna izdaji 2024.12. Ta različica uvaja vgrajen Scheduler, poročila v PDF, prilagodljive CUSTOM stolpce, dinamične nadomestne tokene v snapshot poizvedbah in pametnejšo optimizacijo pragov za izboljšanje zaznavanja anomalij in nadzora kakovosti podatkov.

## Notes

- Every page is also available as raw Markdown: append `.md` to its URL, e.g. `https://docs.digna.ai/platform/overview.md`.
- `llms-full.txt` beside this file carries the full text of every page in one request.
- This documentation is published in 27 languages under a locale prefix (`/de/`, `/fr/`, `/es/`, `/it/`, `/pl/`, `/pt/`, `/sv/`, `/nb/`, `/da/`, `/fi/`, `/et/`, `/lt/`, `/lv/`, `/nl/`, `/cs/`, `/hu/`, `/tr/`, `/ro/`, `/sl/`, `/el/`, `/uk/`, `/ru/`, `/ja/`, `/ko/`, `/hi/`, `/ar/`). Each locale has its own `llms.txt`. The sitemap at https://docs.digna.ai/sitemap.xml lists every URL.
- The marketing site at https://www.digna.ai covers use cases, industry applications and company information not duplicated here.
